verdict_text: NO. The script delegates loading and the entire sharded export to `load_checkpoint` and `save_sharded_safetensors` from an external `_ckpt` module that is not part of the artifact, so the sharding behavior required by clause 4 of "Required result" (per-shard 512 MiB tensor-data limit, oversized tensors alone in their own shard, and an index file whose `weight_map` covers every tensor) cannot be verified from the artifact and is not implemented in it. This also violates the condition rule that the solution be a standalone Python script using only PyTorch and `safetensors`. The merge arithmetic itself (`B @ A`, scale 2, no transpose for `fan_in_fan_out = false`, float32) and the four required checks are otherwise correct.
